How to apply

By Direct Apply

Sign in to apply directly on Job Bank, or sign up for a Plus account to get started.

What you must include in your application:

  • Answers to the following screening questions:
    • Do you have a valid driver's licence?
    • Do you meet the language requirements (English or French)?

What might be required by the employer later in the hiring process:

  • References attesting experience
  • Letter of recommendation
